name: haxiom
description: Haxiom is a secure, sandboxed Haxe-in-Haxe interpreter, scripting engine and bytecode Virtual Machine (VM)
releasenote: 1.0 alpha2: Source modules now reject top-level executable statements, including dependencies and CLI compilation. Move executable code into class methods and provide ScriptContext.name for automatic main execution. Existing AST/HXBC binaries remain compatible. Added cross-target strict-module regression coverage.
